newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Cardoso to visit South Africa.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Cardoso to visit South Africa.

text.p: Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso will visit South Africa from Nov. 26 to 28, the Foreign Ministry said on Friday.
In a statement, it said several agreements were likely to be signed during the visit but did not specify what areas the accords would cover.
The end of apartheid in South Africa and the election of President Nelson Mandela in 1994 made possible a "new phase" in relations, the ministry said.
